Deviations to review: (1) the shape predicate additionally requires the word before the first path to be an interpreter (python*, node, bash, ...) or absent, because `pytest tests/a.py tests/b.py` is a valid multi-suite entry that the description's wording alone would refuse; (2) acceptance 4's second form `scope <manifest> <id>` failed at HEAD (positionals arrive swapped) so the normaliser swaps them when the first slot is a plan file; (3) the batch refusal header now reads 'names a task the plan cannot take' (was 'a fix'); (4) the validator warning skips done/cancelled tasks.
